name: 设计与无障碍
summary: 设计评审、无障碍审查（WCAG 2.1 AA）、设计交付、设计系统与界面文字五个技能，给个人助理、Coding 的界面任务和 Pages 用。

translations.设计评审、无障碍审查（WCAG 2.1 AA）、设计交付、设计系统与界面文字五个: Five Skills for design critique, accessibility review (WCAG 2.1 AA), design handoff, design systems and interface text, for the personal assistant, Coding's interface work and Pages.
translations.按 WCAG 2.1 AA 审查一个页面、组件、设计稿或一段界面代码的无障碍问题: Review a page, component, design or piece of interface code against WCAG 2.1 AA, and write each finding with where it is, the success criterion it fails, who it affects and how to fix it. Use it when someone asks for an accessibility review, asks whether an interface works with only a keyboard or a screen reader, checks accessibility before a release, or wants to confirm that an interface change introduced no new problems.
translations.有具体的对象可看（页面、截图、设计稿、组件代码或能打开的地址），想知道它离 WC: There is something concrete to look at (a page, a screenshot, a design, component code or an address that opens), and you want to know how far it is from WCAG 2.1 AA and what to fix first.
translations.只想听整体设计好不好（用 design-critique）；要写或改界面文字（用: You only want an opinion on the overall design (use design-critique); you want interface text written or changed (use ux-copy); you need legal advice or a formal compliance certification, which this review cannot replace.
translations.<要审查的页面、组件、截图或代码>: <the page, component, screenshot or code to review>
translations.对一个界面、流程或设计稿做结构化的设计评审：先弄清它要帮谁完成什么，再从任务能否: Give a structured design critique of an interface, a flow or a design: first learn whom it helps do what, then look for problems in whether the task can be completed, visual hierarchy, consistency, states and feedback, and density, writing for each the evidence, the impact and a concrete fix, and separating what must change from what to consider. Use it when someone asks for a design review, asks what is wrong with a page or prototype, wants to compare options, or wants a changed interface picked apart.
translations.有能看的东西（截图、设计稿、原型、能打开的页面或界面代码），想知道哪里会让人用不: There is something to look at (a screenshot, a design, a prototype, a page that opens or interface code), and you want to know where people will stumble, fail to see or feel lost, and what to fix first.
translations.只要逐条对照 WCAG 查无障碍（用 accessibility-review）: You only want an accessibility check against WCAG, criterion by criterion (use accessibility-review); you only want text changed (use ux-copy); you want a final design written up for developers to build (use design-handoff); there is no sketch yet, only an idea of what to make.
translations.<要评审的界面、流程或设计稿，以及它要解决的问题>: <the interface, flow or design to review, and the problem it solves>
translations.把定下来的设计整理成开发能照着做、不用再猜的交付说明：范围、每个界面的全部状态、: Turn a settled design into a handoff developers can build from without guessing: scope, every state of each screen, the components and design tokens used, interaction and motion, real text, accessibility requirements, data and edge cases, changes across widths, and open questions; also check what an existing handoff is missing before work starts. Use it when someone writes a design handoff or developer spec, hands a design to developers, or receives a design to implement.
translations.设计已经基本定下，要交给别人（或 Coding）实现；或者手上有一份设计稿或交付: The design is mostly settled and someone else (or Coding) will build it; or you have a design or a handoff and want to know which decisions are still missing before work starts.
translations.设计还在探索、要先挑毛病（用 design-critique）；只查无障碍（用: The design is still being explored and needs critique first (use design-critique); you only want an accessibility check (use accessibility-review); you only want text changed (use ux-copy); you are maintaining the whole set of components and design tokens (use design-system).
translations.<要交付的界面或功能，附设计稿或原型>: <the interface or feature to hand off, with its design or prototype>
translations.在代码里使用、扩展和检查一套设计系统：动手写界面前先找已有的设计变量和组件；确实: Use, extend and audit a design system in code: look for existing design tokens and components before writing interface code; when something new is truly needed, name it by layer, complete its states, themes and accessibility, and add its specimen to the component board; audit a codebase for drift from the design system (hard-coded colours and sizes, one-off components, operating-system controls) and give an order for migrating. Use it when writing or changing interface code, adding a component or design token, or cleaning up interface inconsistencies.
translations.在有设计系统（设计变量、组件库、组件板或设计说明）的项目里写界面代码；要决定是用: You are writing interface code in a project that has a design system (design tokens, a component library, a component board or a design document); you need to decide between reusing and building new; you want to take stock of and gather up inconsistencies in the interface.
translations.评一个界面好不好用（用 design-critique）；查无障碍（用 acce: You want to judge whether an interface is easy to use (use design-critique); you want an accessibility check (use accessibility-review); you are writing a handoff for developers (use design-handoff); the project has no design system yet and this is a one-off prototype.
translations.<要做的界面改动、要新增的组件，或要检查的目录>: <the interface change to make, the component to add, or the folder to audit>
translations.写和改界面文字：按钮、标题、空状态、错误、确认、提示、加载、权限请求和引导。按「: Write and revise interface text: buttons, headings, empty states, errors, confirmations, notices, loading, permission requests and onboarding. Write to say what happened and what can be done next, keep the same words throughout, follow each language's own conventions in Chinese and English, and never join half-sentences or force a count into a sentence. Use it when someone writes or revises interface copy, finds a phrase awkward or unclear, wants the words in one feature made consistent, or needs English for interface text.
translations.有具体的界面或文字要写、要改、要检查，包括一整个流程的文字统一和中英文对照。: There is specific interface text or a specific interface to write for, revise or check, including making a whole flow's words consistent and pairing Chinese with English.
translations.写营销文章、长篇帮助文档或公告；评整体设计（用 design-critique）: Writing marketing articles, long help documents or announcements; judging the overall design (use design-critique); checking accessibility (use accessibility-review, which also points out problems with names and error messages).
translations.<要写或要改的界面文字，或所在的界面>: <the interface text to write or revise, or the interface it is in>
